name: Image Generation Policy
description: Pre-action governance for AI image generation and image editing requests. Enforces provider allowlists, prompt metadata limits, referenced-image limits, output count limits, and output format restrictions without requiring raw prompts or image contents.
advice: Forward only image-generation metadata to policy evaluation; do not forward raw prompt text or image contents.
Use allowed_providers to restrict generation to approved model providers.
Use max_prompt_length to limit accidental prompt or data exfiltration.
Set max_referenced_images to 0 unless the harness can separately authorize each local input image with data.file.read.v1.
Use max_output_images and allowed_output_formats to control cost and artifact types.
Audit provider, model, prompt length, reference count, output count, output format, size, and aspect ratio.

provider.description: Image generation provider, for example openai.

prompt_length.description: Character length of the prompt. Raw prompt text must not be sent to policy evaluation.

referenced_image_count.description: Number of referenced images, not their paths or contents.

evaluation_rules.name: provider_allowlist
evaluation_rules.description: Image generation provider must be allowed.

evaluation_rules.name: prompt_length_limit
evaluation_rules.description: Prompt length must not exceed max_prompt_length.
evaluation_rules.message: Prompt length exceeds the configured limit.

evaluation_rules.name: referenced_image_limit
evaluation_rules.description: Referenced image count must not exceed max_referenced_images.
evaluation_rules.message: Referenced image count exceeds the configured limit.

evaluation_rules.name: output_count_limit
evaluation_rules.description: Requested output count must not exceed max_output_images.
evaluation_rules.message: Requested image count exceeds the configured limit.

evaluation_rules.name: output_format_allowlist
evaluation_rules.description: Output format must be allowed when allowed_output_formats is configured.
